The 2026–27 season is the 140th in the history of [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]], their 35th in the [[Premier League]], and their 52nd consecutive and 102nd overall season in the top flight of [[Football in England|English football]]. The club are competing in the [[2026–27 Premier League|Premier League]], the [[2026–27 FA Cup|FA Cup]], the [[2026–27 EFL Cup|EFL Cup]] and the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]], making their first appearance in the Champions League since the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage|2023–24]] season.

Before the season started, [[Michael Carrick]] was appointed permanent head coach on a two-year contract.<ref>{{cite news |title=Carrick continues as United head coach |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/michael-carrick-continues-as-man-united-head-coach-2026 |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=22 May 2026 |access-date=22 May 2026 }}</ref>

==Pre-season and friendlies==
On 2 April, United confirmed a trip to [[Dublin]] to face [[Leeds United F.C.|Leeds United]] as part of their pre-season preparations.<ref>{{cite news |title=United to face Leeds at Croke Park |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/detail/man-utd-announce-croke-park-friendly-against-leeds-united-in-dublin |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=2 April 2026 |access-date=2 April 2026 }}</ref> On 9 April, United confirmed an additional four fixtures, against [[Wrexham A.F.C.|Wrexham]] in Helsinki, against [[Rosenborg BK|Rosenborg]] in Trondheim, against [[Atlético Madrid]] in Stockholm and against [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]] in Gothenburg.<ref>{{cite news |title=United announce pre-season fixtures |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/detail/man-utd-announce-four-more-pre-season-2026-fixtures |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=9 April 2026 |access-date=9 April 2026 }}</ref>

United lost their first match of pre-season against Wrexham 1–0 as [[Sam Smith (footballer, born 1998)|Sam Smith]] scored the only goal of the game.<ref>{{cite news |first=Jimmy |last=Moorhouse |title=Report: United 0 Wrexham 1 |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/report-united-0-wrexham-1 |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=18 July 2026 |access-date=18 July 2026 }}</ref> United won the next two matches, 5–0 over Rosenborg<ref>{{cite news |first=Isaac |last=Stacey Stronge |title=Rosenborg 0 United 5: Report, reaction and highlights |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/rosenborg-0-united-5-report-reaction-and-highlights |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=24 July 2026 |access-date=25 August 2026 }}</ref> and 2–1 over Atlético Madrid,<ref>{{cite news |first=Dan |last=Burton |title=Report: United 2-1 Atleti |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/report-united-2-1-atleti |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=1 August 2026 |access-date=25 August 2026 }}</ref> followed by 1–1 draws to Paris Saint-Germain and Leeds United.<ref>{{cite news |first=Millie |last=Lumb |title=Report: PSG 1 United 1 |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/report-manchester-united-1-psg-1-aug-2026 |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=8 August 2026 |access-date=25 August 2026 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |first=Jonny |last=Webb |title=United 1 Leeds 1 (United win 5-4 on pens) |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/united-1-leeds-1-manchester-united-win-5-4-on-pens |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=12 August 2026 |access-date=25 August 2026 }}</ref> Manchester United lost their final preseason match 4–2 to a Milan side coached by former United manager [[Ruben Amorim]].<ref>{{cite news |first=Will |last=Moore |title=Match report: United 2 AC Milan 4 |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/match-report-united-ac-milan-15-aug-2026 |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=15 August 2026 |access-date=25 August 2026 }}</ref>

==Premier League==
United's place in the [[2026–27 Premier League]] was confirmed on 15 March 2026. It is their 35th season in the Premier League. The league fixtures were released on 19 June 2026.<ref>{{cite news |title=United's 2026/27 Premier League fixtures |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/official-united-2026-27-premier-league-fixtures |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=19 June 2026 |access-date=19 June 2026 }}</ref>

==FA Cup==
As a Premier League side, United will enter the [[2026–27 FA Cup]] in the third round.

==EFL Cup==
As United are playing in European competition, they entered the [[2026–27 EFL Cup]] in the third round. The draw for the third round took place on 26 August, and paired United with fellow Premier League side [[Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.|Brighton & Hove Albion]]. The game was played in the week of 14 September to avoid a clash with matchday 1 of the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Tottenham in EFL Cup third round |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c62mr6pv65zo |website=BBC Sport |date=26 August 2026 |access-date=27 August 2026 }}</ref> After going 2–0 up inside the opening 10 minutes thanks to goals from [[Shea Lacey]] (on his full debut) and [[Mason Mount]], United conceded on the stroke of half-time before Brighton scored twice in five minutes midway through the second half to give them a 3–2 win. It was the first time United had lost at home after holding a two-goal lead since a 3–2 defeat to Tottenham Hotspur in 1976.<ref>{{cite news |first=Simon |last=Stone |title=Manchester United 2-3 Brighton & Hove Albion: Michael Carrick's side beaten from 2-0 up in Carabao Cup |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cqn8mvgl91zgt |website=BBC Sport |date=16 September 2026 |accessdate=17 September 2026 }}</ref>

==UEFA Champions League==
United qualified for the league phase of the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League]] on 3 May 2026, when they confirmed a top-five finish in the [[2025–26 Premier League]].<ref>{{cite news |first=Simon |last=Stone |title=Manchester United 3-2 Liverpool: Kobbie Mainoo scores winner as they confirm Champions League football |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cwy2421dj2vt |website=BBC Sport |date=3 May 2026 |access-date=8 August 2026 }}</ref>

===League phase===
The draw for the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League league phase|league phase]] took place on 27 August. United were placed in pot 2 for the draw, along with [[Borussia Dortmund|Dortmund]], [[AS Roma|Roma]], [[Sporting CP]], [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]], [[FC Porto|Porto]], [[Club Brugge KV|Club Brugge]], [[Real Betis|Betis]] and [[PSV Eindhoven]]. They were drawn against [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] and [[Atlético Madrid]] from pot 1, Roma and Sporting CP from pot 2, [[RB Leipzig]] and [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]] from pot 3, and [[Sabah FK (Azerbaijan)|Sabah]] and [[Como 1907|Como]] from pot 4.<ref>{{cite news |first=Adam |last=Marshall |title=Who are United playing in the Champions League? |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/who-are-united-playing-in-the-2026-27-champions-league |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=27 August 2026 |access-date=27 August 2026 }}</ref> Fixtures were announced on 29 August, with United opening their campaign at home to Sabah on 10 September and concluding away to Villarreal on 27 January.<ref>{{cite news |first=Sam |last=Carney |title=Champions League dates revealed |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/champions-league-dates-confirmed-2026-27 |website=ManUtd.com |publisher=Manchester United |date=29 August 2026 |access-date=29 August 2026 }}</ref>

===Table===
The top eight teams will advance directly to the round of 16. The teams ranked from 9th to 24th will compete in the knockout phase play-offs, with the teams ranked from 9th to 16th seeded for the draw. Teams ranked from 25th to 36th will be eliminated from European competition.
